class_name: 疑問-問いかけ-モノカ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: is it really all right to …?
patterns.usage_note: Asks what the appropriate course would be, or whether something is permissible: after a past-form verb it deliberates (この件はどう説明したものか), and after いい it questions propriety (子どもに見せていいものか). The sibling lane is the rhetorical denial that refuses an act or rejects a quality outright (二度と行くもんか, 痛いもんか). It usually trails off before 迷う, 悩む, or 考える rather than expecting an answer.

examples.ruby: 新人[しんじん]にこの仕事[しごと]を任[まか]せていいものか、まだ迷[まよ]っている。
examples.english: I still can't decide whether it's really all right to hand this job to the new hire.

examples.ruby: こちらから先[さき]に謝[あやま]ってよいものか、ずっと考[かんが]えている。
examples.english: I've been turning over whether I should be the one to apologize first.

examples.ruby: 拾[ひろ]った財布[さいふ]を交番[こうばん]に届[とど]けなくていいものか。
examples.english: Is it really all right not to take the wallet I found to the police box?
